name: week
title: This week: model reviews
subtitle: Local governance records. No live model telemetry.

sections.title: Reviews to arrange
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,next_review,reason FROM v_review_queue ORDER BY next_review NULLS FIRST,code

sections.title: Remediation due
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,owner,severity,due_on FROM v_actions_due ORDER BY due_on,code

sections.title: Evidence expiry
sections.sql: SELECT code,kind,valid_until,days_left,state FROM v_evidence_due ORDER BY valid_until,code

sections.title: Current record checks
sections.sql: SELECT code,status,has_owner,review_current,approval_current,no_high_actions FROM v_readiness ORDER BY code

sections.title: Accountability and current version
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,department,risk_tier,status,version,next_review FROM v_register ORDER BY code
